selected_evidence.requirement: Automatic cron-driven pickup of a config change within 15 minutes (pre-restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Edited node1's app.conf, then observed node2's crond log an automatic 'sync ok' at 11:05:01 (about 3 minutes later) and confirmed matching md5sum 4a36b8be91d6fa867bb7412247de6d77 on both nodes without any manual trigger.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, sshd/crond active status, crontab contents, and config checksum on both nodes before any restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acked before disconnect; boot_id changed from 8c28f3cd-ef9b-4edb-b26e-9a7a6f76c879 to 8e3a09cd-28c3-43b3-bb51-df2929b5ed44 after a connection-timeout interval; post-restart sshd active, config checksum intact, and node2->node1 SSH plus manual sync re-confirmed functional.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state including cluster sync membership
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acked before disconnect; boot_id changed from 54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03 to 353ebb16-33ff-4046-8dff-45d42c222452 after a connection-timeout interval; post-restart sshd and crond active, crontab persisted, and synced config checksum intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that the automatic sync mechanism still meets the 15-minute freshness requirement
selected_evidence.summary: After both restarts, edited node1's app.conf again; node2's crond automatically logged 'sync ok' at 11:15:01, and md5sum 115b2322c72e7bd87ff202f614fd52be matched on both nodes, confirming the sync mechanism survives node restarts and continues working automatically.

commands.command:
mkdir -p /etc/inventory /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY" > /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 && chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_ed25519
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
grep -qxF "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" /etc/hosts || echo "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> /etc/hosts
ssh-keyscan -H node1 >> /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
echo DONE

ssh -o BatchMode=yes root@node1 'echo ssh-ok'
which crond crontab 2>&1; systemctl is-active crond 2>&1

mkdir -p /usr/local/sbin /var/log
cat > /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
mkdir -p /etc/inventory
rsync -az -e "ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new" root@node1:/etc/inventory/app.conf /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp \
  && mv /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp /etc/inventory/app.conf \
  && echo "$(date -Is) sync ok" >> /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log \
  || echo "$(date -Is) sync FAILED" >> /var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
( crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v sync-inventory-conf.sh ; echo "*/5 * * * * /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh" ) | crontab -
crontab -l
echo DONE
